benchmarks.scope: synthetic VM and memory backends, not Google latency
notes: Per-sheet comparison excludes common VM projection and source capture cost
IO counts are backend calls, not Google RPCs
Header/body byte measures are not native disk allocation
Independent backends are not separate physical devices
Protected legacy archive uses a 14.84 MiB UTF-16 logical measure and is never compacted or removed

limitations: Independent backends are separate DBs/directories on one device/profile, not redundant real services
Authentication and Apps Script/Sheets execution are simulated in VM, not Google OAuth or RPCs
Quota injected in native IDB transactions; no physical quota exhaustion
P6 Chromium process crash tested only in disposable desktop profile; no power loss
WebKit Playwright is not Safari/iOS hardware
A copy never proves latest source state or commits an operation
Format 2 proves current B6 only; no invented historical chain
Full snapshots and P4 32 MiB body limit constrain history growth
Persistent repair locks are never automatically cleared
No P1-P5 or operational files were modified; no routes, writers or restoration methods activated
